newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet volume down, sugar content high.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet volume down, sugar content high.

text.p: German sugar beet deliveries to refineries as of November 22 were 19.73 million tonnes, down from 19.94 million a year earlier, but sugar content was above last year, sugar industry association WVZ said.
The ninth weekly campaign report put average sugar content on Nov 22 at 18.16 percent versus 16.74 percent a year earlier.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final beet deliveries in the 1996/97 campaign at 25.80 million tonnes, down from 26.05 million in 95/96.
WVZ runs delivery updates until the end of the campaign in January on a weekly basis.
Deliveries to refineries up to Nov 15 were 17.51 million tonnes, down from 17.56 million last year, and sugar content on that day was 18.14 percent versus 16.73.
